raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  tests_to_skip: tests.test_structural.CentralityTests.testAuthorityScore
  name: python-igraph
  pypiname: igraph
  version: "1.0.0"
  igraph_version: "1.0.0"

package:
  name: ${{ name|lower }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://files.pythonhosted.org/packages/source/${{ pypiname[0] }}/${{ pypiname }}/${{ pypiname }}-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 2414d0be2e4d77ee5357807d100974b40f6082bb1bb71988ec46cfb6728651ee
  patches:
    - 0001-allow-pkgconf.patch

build:
  number: 2

requirements:
  build:
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then: python
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then: cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
    - ${{ compiler('c') }}
    - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
    - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
    - pkgconf
  host:
    - python
    - pip
    - setuptools >=64
    - igraph ${{ igraph_version }}.*
  run:
    - python
    - texttable >=1.6.2

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - igraph
        - igraph.app
        - igraph.drawing
        - igraph.remote
      pip_check: false
  - files:
      source:
        - tests
    script:
      - python -m unittest -v

about:
  license: GPL-2.0-or-later
  license_file: LICENSE
  summary: High performance graph data structures and algorithms
  homepage: https://igraph.org/python/
  repository: https://github.com/igraph/python-igraph
  documentation: https://igraph.org/python/#docs

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - sodre
    - vtraag
    - xylar
